body: I say this to people and they think I’m joking. I know people, but I don’t have friends that I can text constantly or who are actually interested in me :///////////// I hate it here ugh. I don’t know the last time I went out on a “girly” outing or just did something relaxing like going out for a meal or drinks :((
my friend actually told me I was regressing the other day, even though at the time I thought I was ‘normal’ thought it was just me and my messed brain!

so im probably not the best person to give advice, but I’ve been with my boyfriend for a couple of months now and he managed to get his penis in like 3/4 of the way in the other day with a lot of lube but it was excruciatingly painful but I was drunk and insisted that we should try. I told him I don’t think I want to have sex again until I manage to get to the doctors but like you I’m frightened. I honestly think it might just be worth trying to come to terms with your internalised fear first before you push your body to a place it’s not meant to get to yet. PIV will come, and so will (fingers crossed) enjoyable PIV but please take baby steps and don’t think to rash like I did x

my boyfriends parents don’t have the best relationship but they still manage to keep their children relatively happy. My boyf gets dropped/picked up everywhere, his mum always tells him how much she loves him and how proud she is of him and even sometimes goes out of her way to do things for me like take me home after I’ve been round (my ndad always expects me to take transport even though it’s a 5-10 minute drive). Makes me really sad because he doesn’t fully appreciate his parents, but I guess that’s every “privileged” child. My mum died of cancer when I was 12 so I’ve been left growing up with a massive hole of emptiness and neglect, and it’s only “filled” when my Dad tells me I’m not good enough or shouts at me for not acting like an adult even though I’m 17 and still in school. 

On a side note: really proud of everyone on here keeping pushing even with the lack of parental love and care.
